html:
G'oya

Bo'limlar bo'yicha guruhlab, MAX(salary) - MIN(salary) ni hisoblaymiz: agregatlar ifodada oddiy sonlar kabi ishlatiladi. Bitta xodimli bo'limlarni HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2 olib tashlaydi.

Yechim

SELECT department, MAX(salary) - MIN(salary) AS salary_gap
FROM employees
GROUP BY department
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2

Namunada IT: 9000 - 6000 = 3000, Moliya: 500. HR'da bitta xodim, u chiqmaydi.

Tuzoqlar

HAVING siz HR ham chiqadi, farqi 0. Bitta xodimda eng katta va eng kichik maosh bir xil:

Noto'g'riSELECT department, MAX(salary) - MIN(salary) AS salary_gap
FROM employees
GROUP BY department

Bitta xodimli bo'limni HAVING MAX(salary) > MIN(salary) bilan olib tashlashga urinmang. Ikki xodimning maoshi teng bo'lsa, bo'lim natijada qolishi kerak, farqi 0. Xuddi shu sababdan COUNT(DISTINCT salary) ham to'g'ri kelmaydi: shart xodimlar soni haqida, har xil maoshlar soni haqida emas.
